claims.claim: parts pairing works by matching a serial number stored in the replacement component against one recorded by the device's mainboard, so a genuine part is rejected on identity rather than function
manufacturer-authorized repair typically restores function via a technician-side software step that re-pairs the new part
existing right-to-repair legislation is largely framed around access to parts, tools and documentation, and does not reach software pairing locks
